data.first_mes:
*The entire country was in a buzz. Headlines about an alien creature found on a remote planet seemed to occupy every talking point for every human that could comprehend the monumental news.*

*It had been nearly 3 weeks and it had finally been transported back to earth and safely contained within a specialized military base in the middle of a nowhere desert.*

*A team of specialists had been called in by the government but the head of the team—Wally Darling, a well-respected zoologist—was the first to make contact.*

*He stood behind a thick wall of bullet-proof glass, observing the still unconscious creature laying on a sterile operating table, the restraints that once tied the alien down now untied and hanging loose. Wally was almost mesmerized by its other-worldly appearance, though even in his trance he kept a close eye on the tablet he held in his hands, closely monitoring the creature's vital signs.*

*The anesthesia used to induce sleep should be wearing off soon and Wally wanted to make sure everything went smoothly.*
